text_a: The cashier must not accept cards that are expired, or checks that are post-dated.
text_b: The cashier must not accept cards that are expired, or checks that are not post-dated.
what_differs: The negation moves into the relative clause, so the rule now bans ordinary checks and allows post-dated ones instead of banning post-dated checks.

text_a: No se debe compartir la contraseña de administrador con personal externo.
text_b: El personal externo no debe recibir la contraseña de administrador compartida.

text_a: Não é permitido liberar o pagamento antes da aprovação do gerente, mas o pedido pode ser cadastrado antes.
text_b: É permitido liberar o pagamento antes da aprovação do gerente, mas o pedido não pode ser cadastrado antes.
what_differs: The negation switches from the payment release to the order registration, so each action gets the opposite permission.

text_a: Never leave the freezer door open for more than thirty seconds.
text_b: Do not keep the freezer door open longer than thirty seconds.

text_a: Los técnicos no deben apagar los servidores de prueba, excepto los del equipo de QA.
text_b: Los técnicos deben apagar los servidores de prueba, excepto los del equipo de QA.
what_differs: The negation is dropped from the modal clause, reversing the obligation from a prohibition to a requirement while the exception stays the same.

text_a: Ninguém pode alterar a tabela de preços sem aprovação do financeiro.
text_b: A tabela de preços só pode ser alterada com aprovação do financeiro.

text_a: Staff must not photograph patients, but they may record the audio of consultations.
text_b: Staff must not photograph patients or record the audio of consultations.
what_differs: The second text extends the prohibition to audio recording, which the first text explicitly permits.

text_a: Ningún visitante debe entrar a la sala de servidores sin escolta.
text_b: Los visitantes no pueden entrar a la sala de servidores si no van acompañados.

text_a: O estagiário não deve assinar contratos sem a presença de um sócio.
text_b: O estagiário deve assinar contratos sem a presença de um sócio.
what_differs: Removing the negation reverses the rule: the first forbids signing without a partner present, the second requires it.

text_a: Don't let anyone without a visitor pass past the lobby.
text_b: Nobody without a visitor pass may get past the lobby.

text_a: Do not submit the invoice until the purchase order is approved, and do not pay it before the goods arrive.
text_b: Do not submit the invoice until the purchase order is approved, and pay it before the goods arrive.
what_differs: The negation in the second clause is dropped, so paying before the goods arrive changes from forbidden to required.

text_a: No se permite fumar en el depósito ni comer en la oficina de carga.
text_b: En el depósito está prohibido fumar, y en la oficina de carga está prohibido comer.

text_a: All visitors must sign in except the contractors who have a standing badge.
text_b: All visitors must sign in except the contractors, who have a standing badge.
what_differs: The comma turns a restrictive relative into a non-restrictive one, so the exemption shifts from badge-holding contractors to all contractors.

text_a: Todos los empleados deben usar casco, salvo quienes trabajen en oficinas.
text_b: Quienes trabajan en oficinas no tienen que usar casco; los demás empleados sí deben usarlo.

text_a: Todos os funcionários devem registrar o ponto, exceto os gerentes.
text_b: Todos os funcionários devem registrar o ponto, exceto os gerentes e os diretores.
what_differs: The second text adds directors to the exempt set, so directors are no longer required to clock in.

text_a: Everyone except the night staff must complete the safety course by Friday.
text_b: Apart from the night crew, all employees have to finish the safety course by Friday.

text_a: Se pueden usar los ascensores, excepto el de carga, en horas pico.
text_b: Se pueden usar los ascensores, excepto el de carga y el de servicio, en horas pico.
what_differs: The second text adds the service elevator to the excluded set, so one more elevator becomes off-limits during peak hours.

text_a: Todos devem usar crachá, a não ser os visitantes escoltados.
text_b: Os visitantes escoltados são os únicos que podem dispensar o crachá.

text_a: Except for the reporting server, all servers must be patched on Mondays.
text_b: Except for the reporting server and the backup server, all servers must be patched on Mondays.
what_differs: The second text exempts the backup server as well, so that server is no longer required to be patched on Mondays.

text_a: Salvo los cajeros, el personal debe cerrar la caja antes de salir.
text_b: El personal debe cerrar la caja antes de salir, excepto los cajeros.

text_a: Exceto em caso de emergência, ninguém deve sair do laboratório sem avisar.
text_b: Ninguém deve sair do laboratório sem avisar, exceto se for uma emergência médica.
what_differs: The second text narrows the exception to medical emergencies, so other emergencies no longer excuse leaving without notice.

text_a: Puede publicarse cualquier informe, salvo los financieros que sean internos.
text_b: Puede publicarse cualquier informe, salvo los financieros.
what_differs: The second text drops the internal qualifier, so all financial reports are excluded instead of only the internal ones.

text_a: Every employee except interns may request remote work after the probation period.
text_b: Interns aside, all employees can ask to work remotely once their probation is over.

text_a: Todos los proveedores, menos los de Asia, deben entregar factura electrónica.
text_b: Los proveedores de Asia quedan fuera; los demás deben entregar factura electrónica.

text_a: Can I approve refunds myself? Yes, up to 50 dollars per month.
text_b: Can I approve refunds myself? Yes, up to 50 dollars per ticket.
what_differs: The cap changes from a monthly total to a per-ticket limit, which allows far more cumulative refunds.

text_a: ¿Puedo cancelar el pedido después de enviarlo? No, salvo que el cliente lo pida por escrito.
text_b: ¿Puedo cancelar el pedido después de enviarlo? No. Solo si el cliente lo solicita por escrito.

text_a: Posso ausentar-me sem aviso? Não, exceto em caso médico com comprovante.
text_b: Posso ausentar-me sem aviso? Não, exceto em caso médico, sem comprovante.
what_differs: The second text drops the proof requirement for medical absences, so employees can leave without notice and without documentation.

text_a: Can I return an opened item? Yes, provided it still has the seal.
text_b: Can I return an opened item? Yes, as long as the seal is intact.

text_a: ¿Puedo llevar mi perro a la oficina? Sí, pero solo uno por equipo.
text_b: ¿Puedo llevar mi perro a la oficina? Sí, pero solo uno por persona.
what_differs: The limit unit changes from one dog per team to one dog per person, which permits several dogs per team.

text_a: Posso acumular férias? Sim, até 30 dias por ano.
text_b: Posso acumular férias? Sim, desde que não passe de 30 dias por ano.

text_a: Can contractors access the VPN? Yes, but only from company devices.
text_b: Can contractors access the VPN? Yes, but only from company devices or from home.
what_differs: The second text adds home as an allowed location, widening the restriction the first text imposes.

text_a: ¿Se puede usar el coche de la empresa para viajes personales? No, salvo con autorización escrita.
text_b: ¿Se puede usar el coche de la empresa para viajes personales? No, a menos que haya autorización escrita.

text_a: Is overtime allowed on weekends? No, unless a manager signs the request.
text_b: Is overtime allowed on weekends? No. Only a manager's signed request allows it.

text_a: Posso reembolsar a despesa sem nota? Sim, mas só até 100 reais, com nota.
text_b: Posso reembolsar a despesa sem nota? Sim, mas só até 100 reais, sem nota.
what_differs: Changing with to without flips the documentation requirement, so the reimbursement is only allowed without a receipt.

text_a: May I bring a guest to the event? Yes, as long as the guest signs in at the desk.
text_b: May I bring a guest to the event? Yes, provided the guest checks in at the front desk.

text_a: Submit the timesheet on Monday and the expense report by Friday.
text_b: Submit the timesheet by Monday and the expense report on Friday.
what_differs: The Monday and Friday deadlines swap between the two actions, changing which document is due on which day.

text_a: Entregue el informe antes del viernes a las 17:00.
text_b: El informe debe estar entregado a más tardar el viernes a las cinco de la tarde.

text_a: Pague o fornecedor até dia 10 e envie a nota até dia 15.
text_b: Pague o fornecedor até dia 15 e envie a nota até dia 10.
what_differs: The two day-of-month deadlines are attached to the opposite actions, so payment and invoice dates are swapped.

text_a: Backups run nightly at 02:00 UTC.
text_b: Every night, at two in the morning UTC, the backup starts.

text_a: Cierre la caja a las 20:00 y limpie el local después de las 21:00.
text_b: Cierre la caja después de las 20:00 y limpie el local a las 21:00.
what_differs: The clock times are attached to the other action, so closing becomes a fixed time and cleaning becomes a fixed time instead of the reverse.

text_a: A reunião começa às 9h e termina antes das 12h.
text_b: Ela começa às nove da manhã e termina antes do meio-dia.

text_a: Rotate the keys within 24 hours of an incident, but report it immediately.
text_b: Rotate the keys within 24 hours of an incident, but report it within 24 hours.
what_differs: The reporting deadline changes from immediately to within 24 hours, which allows a delay in notifying the team.

text_a: Notifique al cliente el mismo día que se apruebe el cambio.
text_b: El cliente debe recibir la notificación el día en que se apruebe el cambio.

text_a: El pago se realiza el 5 de cada mes; el reporte, el 1 de cada mes.
text_b: El pago se realiza el 1 de cada mes; el reporte, el 5 de cada mes.
what_differs: The day-of-month values are swapped between payment and report, so each action now has the other date.

text_a: Submit the form no later than the last working day of the month.
text_b: The form must reach us by the final business day of each month at the latest.

text_a: Feche o caixa até as 18h, mas conte o dinheiro só às 19h.
text_b: Feche o caixa às 18h, mas conte o dinheiro até as 19h.
what_differs: The 18h and 19h times move from exact-time to deadline role, so counting may begin before 19h in the second text.

text_a: Staff must lock the cabinet, but they may leave the key with a supervisor.
text_b: Staff may lock the cabinet, but they must leave the key with a supervisor.
what_differs: The modals swap verbs, so locking becomes optional and leaving the key with a supervisor becomes mandatory.

text_a: Usted debe firmar el acta y puede enviar una copia por correo.
text_b: Usted puede enviar una copia del acta por correo, pero debe firmarla.

text_a: O cliente deve assinar o termo e pode levar uma cópia.
text_b: O cliente pode assinar o termo e deve levar uma cópia.
what_differs: The obligation and the permission swap actions, so signing becomes optional and taking a copy becomes compulsory.

text_a: You should back up the laptop before travel, and you can ask IT for a loaner.
text_b: Before travelling, you are advised to back up your laptop, and IT may lend you one.

text_a: Los nuevos empleados pueden usar la impresora, pero deben pedir el código.
text_b: Los nuevos empleados deben usar la impresora, pero pueden pedir el código.
what_differs: The debe and puede swap their actions, so using the printer becomes required and requesting the code becomes optional.

text_a: Os visitantes podem usar o wi-fi, mas precisam de senha.
text_b: Para usar o wi-fi, os visitantes precisam de senha, e isso é permitido.

text_a: Drivers must not text, but they may use hands-free calls.
text_b: Drivers may not text, but they must use hands-free calls.
what_differs: Hands-free calls change from permitted to mandatory, while the ban on texting stays the same.

text_a: Puede retirar el reembolso en efectivo, aunque se recomienda la transferencia.
text_b: Es posible cobrar el reembolso en efectivo; no obstante, la transferencia es lo recomendado.

text_a: Você pode cancelar a reserva sem multa, mas deve avisar com 48 horas.
text_b: Você deve cancelar a reserva sem multa, mas pode avisar com 48 horas.
what_differs: The modal verbs swap their actions, so cancelling becomes mandatory and giving 48 hours notice becomes optional.

text_a: Managers may approve leave, provided HR is informed.
text_b: Leave can be approved by a manager as long as HR is told.

text_a: El técnico debe revisar el equipo antes de instalarlo.
text_b: Antes de instalar el equipo, el técnico tiene la obligación de revisarlo.

text_a: Keep at least three copies of each backup, on two media types.
text_b: Keep at most three copies of each backup, on two media types.
what_differs: The bound flips from a minimum to a maximum on the number of copies, so keeping two copies becomes the wrong direction.

text_a: Se permiten como máximo cinco intentos de inicio de sesión.
text_b: No se admiten más de cinco intentos de inicio de sesión.

text_a: Aceite no mínimo cinco candidatos por vaga.
text_b: Aceite no máximo cinco candidatos por vaga.
what_differs: Minimum and maximum are swapped, so the rule requires at least five candidates in the first and at most five in the second.

text_a: Fewer than ten people may join the session.
text_b: No more than nine people may join the session.

text_a: Reserve more than two parking spaces only with approval.
text_b: Reserve fewer than two parking spaces only with approval.
what_differs: Changing more than to fewer than reverses the threshold, so the approval requirement applies to the opposite quantity range.

text_a: No máximo 3 dispositivos podem estar conectados ao mesmo tempo.
text_b: Até três dispositivos podem estar conectados simultaneamente.

text_a: Cada supervisor debe revisar al menos 10 pedidos por día.
text_b: Cada supervisor debe revisar a lo sumo 10 pedidos por día.
what_differs: The bound changes from a floor of ten reviews to a ceiling of ten, reversing the workload requirement.

text_a: Sell at least two units per customer.
text_b: Each customer must buy two units or more.

text_a: Mais de 20 colaboradores devem fazer o treinamento.
text_b: Pelo menos 20 colaboradores devem fazer o treinamento.
what_differs: Mais de excludes exactly twenty while pelo menos includes it, so the group of exactly twenty staff is covered only in the second text.

text_a: Un máximo de dos invitados por reserva.
text_b: Cada reserva admite hasta dos invitados.

text_a: Process no more than 500 records per batch.
text_b: Process no fewer than 500 records per batch.
what_differs: The bound reverses direction from a ceiling of 500 to a floor of 500 records per batch.

text_a: The auditor must approve the change before the engineer deploys it.
text_b: The engineer must approve the change before the auditor deploys it.
what_differs: The approver and the deployer swap roles, so a different person is authorized to approve and to deploy.

text_a: El cliente recibe la factura por correo electrónico.
text_b: La factura le es enviada por correo electrónico al cliente.

text_a: O sistema envia o alerta ao gerente, que aprova o pedido.
text_b: O gerente envia o alerta ao sistema, que aprova o pedido.
what_differs: The sender and recipient of the alert are reversed, so the manager is no longer the one notified.

text_a: The supervisor signs off on every shift report.
text_b: Every shift report is signed off by the supervisor.

text_a: El médico notifica al paciente la cita; la enfermera la confirma.
text_b: El médico confirma la cita al paciente; la enfermera la notifica.
what_differs: Notifying and confirming are swapped between the doctor and the nurse, so each one performs the other's task.

text_a: A equipe de suporte resolve o chamado e registra a solução.
text_b: O chamado é resolvido pela equipe de suporte, que registra a solução.

text_a: Customers should be told by the agent, not the bot, about refunds.
text_b: Customers should be told by the bot, not the agent, about refunds.
what_differs: The agent and the bot swap the notifying role, so refund messages are now delivered by the automated system instead of a person.

text_a: Solo el administrador puede modificar los permisos.
text_b: Los permisos únicamente pueden ser modificados por el administrador.

text_a: O financeiro aprova o pagamento ao fornecedor após a entrega.
text_b: O fornecedor aprova o pagamento ao financeiro após a entrega.
what_differs: The subject and the indirect object swap, so the supplier becomes the approver and finance the payee.

text_a: Operators restart the service after the patch is applied.
text_b: After the patch is applied, the service is restarted by operators.

text_a: La jefa aprueba los viáticos que presenta el empleado.
text_b: Los viáticos que presenta el empleado son aprobados por la jefa.

text_a: Refunds are issued only if the item was returned unused.
text_b: Refunds are issued if the item was returned unused.
what_differs: Dropping only from if makes the unused-return condition sufficient instead of necessary, so other cases may also qualify.

text_a: Solo se abre el expediente si hay una denuncia formal.
text_b: No se abre el expediente salvo que exista una denuncia formal.

text_a: Os dados serão apagados se o cliente pedir, mas não antes de 30 dias.
text_b: Os dados serão apagados se o cliente pedir, mesmo antes de 30 dias.
what_differs: The second text removes the 30-day waiting condition, so data may be erased before that period expires.

text_a: Unless the ticket is escalated, the agent handles it alone.
text_b: The agent handles the ticket alone, except when it is escalated.

text_a: El gasto se aprueba siempre que haya presupuesto, aunque falte la factura.
text_b: El gasto se aprueba siempre que haya presupuesto, salvo que falte la factura.
what_differs: The exception clause flips from concession to restriction, so a missing invoice no longer allows approval in the second text.

text_a: Só libere o acesso se o contrato estiver assinado.
text_b: Libere o acesso somente quando o contrato estiver assinado.

text_a: Notify the client when the payment fails, unless the card is a test card.
text_b: Notify the client only when the payment fails, unless the card is a test card.
what_differs: Adding only to when restricts notifications to failures, while the first text does not exclude notifying the client in other cases.

text_a: Cuando el sensor detecte humo, la alarma suena, a menos que esté en mantenimiento.
text_b: La alarma suena cada vez que el sensor detecta humo, salvo durante el mantenimiento.

text_a: Você só pode editar o documento se for o autor.
text_b: Você pode editar o documento, se for o autor.
what_differs: The restrictive only changes whether authorship is necessary, so the second text allows editing as a general permission.

text_a: If the patient is under sixteen, a guardian must consent.
text_b: A guardian must consent whenever the patient is under sixteen.

text_a: El alumno aprueba si obtiene al menos el 60 % en el examen final.
text_b: El alumno aprueba solo si obtiene más del 60 % en el examen final.
what_differs: The threshold changes from at least 60 percent to more than 60 percent, so a student scoring exactly 60 percent passes only in the first text.
